{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute the change in biomarker from baseline to final
df['biomarker_change'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Check for missing values in the new column
print("Missing values in biomarker_change:")
print(df['biomarker_change'].isnull().sum())

# Show summary of change
display(df['biomarker_change'].describe())"}
